    sign = v >> (ebits + fbits)

    W = 1 + ebits + fbits
    vals = set()
    def add(s, e, f):
        vals.add((s << (W - 1)) | (e << fbits) | f)

import json, random, struct, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/app")
from main import solve

random.seed(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 7)
W = 64
def f2b(x): return struct.unpack(">Q", struct.pack(">d", x))[0]
def b2f(b): return struct.unpack(">d", struct.pack(">Q", b))[0]

fails = 0
N = 300000
interesting = [0x0000000000000000, 0x8000000000000000, 0x0000000000000001,
               0x8000000000000001, 0x000FFFFFFFFFFFFF, 0x0010000000000000,
               0x7FEFFFFFFFFFFFFF, 0x7FEFFFFFFFFFFFFE, 0x3FF0000000000000,
               0xBFF0000000000000, 0x5FEFFFFFFFFFFFFF, 0x1FF0000000000000,
               0x2000000000000000, 0x5FF0000000000000, 0x7F00000000000000]
for i in range(N):
    if i < len(interesting)**2:
        a = interesting[i // len(interesting)]; b = interesting[i % len(interesting)]
    else:
        a = random.getrandbits(64); b = random.getrandbits(64)
        # force finite
        if (a >> 52) & 0x7FF == 0x7FF: a &= ~(0x7FF << 52)
        if (b >> 52) & 0x7FF == 0x7FF: b &= ~(0x7FF << 52)
    req = {"ebits": 11, "fbits": 52, "mode": "RNE",
           "pairs": [[format(a, "x"), format(b, "x")]]}
    got = solve(req)
    exp = f2b(b2f(a) * b2f(b))
    # underflow flag check: hardware doesn't tell us; check bits only,
    # plus inexact/overflow plausibility via exact value
    if int(got["bits"], 16) != exp:
        print("BITS MISMATCH", hex(a), hex(b), got, hex(exp))
        fails += 1
        if fails > 5: break
print("float cross-check done,", N, "cases,", fails, "failures")
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
